posts.title: 储能如何变革工业用电
posts.summary: 峰谷套利、需量管理与绿电消纳：工商业储能的三重经济账。
posts.author: SOLARIS 解决方案团队
posts.content:
峰谷套利

两充两放的运行策略让工商业储能的投资回收期缩短到 4~5 年，电价差越大、负荷越稳，收益越清晰。

需量管理

储能削峰可以把月度需量电费降低 20%~35%，对高载制造的账单影响立竿见影。

绿电消纳

配储后的光伏自发自用率从 60% 提升到 90% 以上，绿电真正变成可调度的资产。
posts.i18nJson:
{"en-US":{"title":"How Energy Storage Is Transforming Industrial Power","summary":"Arbitrage, demand management and green-power consumption: the three-way economics of C&I storage.","content":"

Peak-valley arbitrage

A two-charge-two-discharge strategy shortens C&I storage payback to 4-5 years — the wider the spread and steadier the load, the clearer the return.

Demand management

Peak shaving cuts monthly demand charges by 20-35%, visible on the very next bill for heavy manufacturing.

Green-power consumption

Storage lifts PV self-consumption from 60% to above 90%, turning green power into a dispatchable asset.

"}}

posts.title: 电池储能技术的未来趋势
posts.summary: 大电芯、液冷温控与构网型变流器，正在定义下一代储能系统。
posts.author: 行业观察
posts.content:
300Ah+ 大电芯把系统成本再压一档；全液冷温控让电芯温差收敛到 3℃ 以内，寿命与安全同步提升。

构网型变流器让储能在弱电网与孤岛场景下也能支撑电压与频率，微电网从此成为常态选项。
posts.i18nJson:
{"en-US":{"title":"The Future of Battery Storage: Key Trends","summary":"Large cells, liquid cooling and grid-forming converters are defining the next generation of storage.","content":"

300Ah+ cells push system costs down another notch; full liquid cooling converges cell temperature spread to within 3℃, improving lifetime and safety together.

Grid-forming converters let storage support voltage and frequency in weak grids and islands — microgrids become a standard option.

"}}

posts.summary: 从安全标准到 AI 调度，盘点这一年值得关注的五件事。

posts.content: 1. 安全标准全面收紧，pack 级消防成为标配；2. AI 调度从概念走向返单；3. 长时储能需求抬头；4. 模块化交付缩短工期；5. 绿电长协与储能打包成新的商业模型。
